name: Huawei Quick Charge 2.0 Power Bank - 10,000mAh
description:
Keep your devices powered up on the go with this high-capacity 10,000mAh power bank. Designed for convenience and speed, it features Quick Charge 2.0 for super-fast charging, ensuring most smartphones are powered up quickly. The universal USB port allows charging of any USB-compatible device, while the four-light LED status indicator keeps you informed about remaining battery and charging progress. Rechargeable via USB-C or Micro USB, it’s built to be portable and reliable.

Technical Specifications:

Quick Charge Function (2.0) for faster charging

Capacity: 10,000 mAh

Input: 5V–9V / 2A

Output: 5V–9V / 2A

Anti-slip design for secure handling

Battery Type: Li-Polymer

Perfect for smartphones, tablets, and other USB devices, this power bank ensures you stay connected wherever you go.
